statement: Preserve MovieLens temporary-root custody when Cell stop or node shutdown fails during closeWorkloadSession or closeFailedOpening, remove the raw DELETE FROM wasm_operations reset path from movielens-public-request-workload-adapter.js, and replace it with isolated-session reset owned by the live workload session and verified by createMovielensLagrangeCapacityAdapter.

constraints.statement: closeWorkloadSession and closeFailedOpening must not remove temporaryRoot when Cell stop or node shutdown fails or remains unconfirmed.
Remove DELETE FROM wasm_operations and in-place journal deletion from movielens-public-request-workload-adapter.js with no fallback or journal-clear API.

Resetting Lagrange capacity state must drain and close the prior isolated session, open a fresh isolated session with verified empty durable results and invocation journal, and verify that the fresh session's runtime owner evidence and adapter identity match the sealed adapter identity.
